title: Above the 911? Porsche previews a new mid-engined supercar.
gist: Porsche unveiled the Mission S concept, a mid-engined supercar to sit above the 911 as a regular production model, as part of a plan to restore double-digit margins by 2035 after margins fell from 18 percent to 1 percent. It is expected to be combustion-powered, likely a flat-eight, and has no infotainment screen.

insights.claim: Porsche's profit margin collapsed from 18 percent three years ago to just 1 percent last year, and has recovered only a little since.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A margin collapse of this size is the driver behind Porsche's strategic reset.
insights.locator: Things have been tough for the German automaker

insights.claim: Porsche's plan, Sportwagenschmiede '35, aims to return to double-digit margins by 2035 by prioritizing value over volume, with greater customer individualization and the higher selling prices that come with it.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Watch for pricing power and personalization revenue as the margin levers rather than volume growth.
insights.locator: Porsche’s board has a plan to get back to double-digit margins

insights.claim: Porsche's restructuring includes laying off 9,000 people as part of a larger Volkswagen Group headcount reduction over the next decade.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Cost cutting is part of the margin recovery alongside the product push.
insights.locator: Some of that restructuring will involve laying off 9,000 people

insights.claim: Planned Porsche models include the electric 718 Boxster/Cayman, a smaller SUV below the Macan due in 2028 with gasoline and plug-in powertrains, and new models in larger, pricier segments alongside the Cayenne and Panamera.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: The pipeline mixes EV, ICE and plug-in hybrids and moves up-market in high-margin segments.
insights.locator: But new models are planned, too

insights.claim: The Mission S is a mid-engined supersports car platform above the 911 that will be a regular production model and a permanent addition to the range, not a limited run like the Carrera GT or 918 Spyder.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A permanent halo-tier product adds a high-margin segment to the lineup.
insights.quote: not as a one-off hypercar, but as a permanent and versatile addition to our customer offering

insights.claim: The Mission S has no passenger display or central infotainment screen; the driver's smartphone docks onto a MagSafe connector, with a mix of haptic and digital feedback.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Porsche is betting some buyers reject screen-heavy cabins, a design signal for premium cars.

insights.claim: No powertrain was disclosed, but rear exhaust pipes imply an internal combustion engine, likely a flat-eight behind the cockpit, with forced induction or hybridization plausible given Porsche's recent electric T-Hybrid system.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A combustion-led halo car shows Porsche is not going EV-only at the top of the range.
insights.locator: We don’t have any information on the Mission S’s powertrain
